summary: Register the existing plastic_trash_bin.glb asset as a 40x40x60 cm catalog module, give it mini-fridge-style 10 cm free movement without overlap exceptions, expose it in catalog drag/Add flows, and include it in automatic depot contents without floor-fixture overlap.

impactAnalysis.notes: The user explicitly set the trash-bin nominal product dimensions to 40x40x60 cm. The previously measured raw GLB transform scale is not used as product dimensions; the existing model renderer normalizes model geometry to descriptor bounds. Exact product identity is DEPOT_PLASTIC_TRASH_BIN and modelFile is plastic_trash_bin.glb. The new item remains decision-required under F-014; no BOM classification is invented. Automatic depot packing is derived from the catalog dimensions and keeps the trash bin, mini fridge and coat rack footprints disjoint; kettle retains its existing supported fridge-top relationship. Existing generic catalog Add behavior is preserved rather than inventing a new default free-placement position in this feature.

e2e.reason: Catalog visibility, drag/drop, Add picker admission, model rendering/persistence, and automatic depot composition are browser-visible behavior and require Chromium coverage.

risk.notes: The change admits a new active catalog product and automatic-depot content. Primary risks are catalog identity drift, incorrect GLB normalization, free-placement behavior drift, or fixture overlap. Targeted unit and Chromium tests cover these paths while the full suite/build protect existing modules.

migration.notes: No persisted schema version changes. New projects may persist DEPOT_PLASTIC_TRASH_BIN catalog identity and the existing project-state format already stores the required descriptor/state fields.

rollback: Revert the trash-bin catalog/behavior/contract/auto-depot commits while leaving the already-merged plastic_trash_bin.glb asset in public/models if any product integration regression is observed.
